verdict.rationale: llama.cpp documents loading a model from the command line (`llama cli -hf ...`) and CPU+GPU hybrid inference that partially offloads a model to the GPU. Community reports confirm a configurable GPU-layer setting (N_GPU_LAYERS) and GPU/CPU model splitting, though the setting was used via Python wrappers rather than the CLI. missing for 10: a documented CLI flag for setting the number of offloaded GPU layers, any evidence of a context-length setting, and hands-on corroboration of configuring these from the CLI.

support.subject: As a developer, I can load a model with custom GPU offload and context length settings from the command line

citations.quote: CPU+GPU hybrid inference to partially accelerate models larger than the total VRAM capacity
seemed limited to a max of 40 N_GPU_LAYERS before updating
